summary: Nielen Schuman is corporate Finance beyond the obvious, founded in 2002. Type: private company. About 43 employees (LinkedIn page). Recognised visa sponsor (IND). 100% of its 2 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.

insights.one_liner: Nielen Schuman is a 43-person Amsterdam corporate finance boutique, calling itself the largest independent one in the Benelux, and an IND recognised sponsor.

culture.text: A small team of about 43 people in Amsterdam doing M&A advice, capital raising and restructuring for medium to large companies and investors.
Staff come heavily from Erasmus University Rotterdam (including RSM and Erasmus School of Economics), the University of Amsterdam and VU Amsterdam, mostly in economics and finance.

open.text: Recognised by the IND as a visa sponsor (Nielen Schuman B.V.).

growth.text: Founded in 2002, it says it has closed more than 500 transactions worth over EUR 50 billion.
